He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon Ducks]]. ==High school career== [[File:Louis King.jpg|thumb|left|King in 2017]] Born in [[Secaucus, New Jersey]] as one of eight children,[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/k/king-louis.aspx Louis King - USA Basketball] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180907032526/https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/k/king-louis.aspx |date=2018-09-07 }}. Accessed September 6, 2018. "Birthplace: Secaucus, New Jersey; Parents: Ativea & Louis King; Siblings: 7"{{cite web|title=Oregon Ducks Bio|url=https://goducks.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=8108|access-date=August 25, 2018|archive-date=August 25, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825143305/https://goducks.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=8108|url-status=live}} King attended [[Roselle Catholic High School]] for his freshman year and [[Pope John XXIII Regional High School]] as a sophomore, before transferring to [[Hudson Catholic Regional High School]] in [[Jersey City, New Jersey]] mid-year, where he had to sit out for the remainder of the season.Sigel, Ben. [https://247sports.com/college/syracuse/Article/2018-forward-Louis-King-enrolls-at-Hudson-Catholic-will-sit-out-remainder-of-season-75011017/ "Louis King enrolls at Hudson Catholic"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180907032352/https://247sports.com/college/syracuse/Article/2018-forward-Louis-King-enrolls-at-Hudson-Catholic-will-sit-out-remainder-of-season-75011017/ |date=2018-09-07 }}, [[247Sports.com]], February 9, 2016. Accessed September 8, 2018. "Today, Schneider is reporting that King has enrolled at Hudson Catholic (NJ), but will sit out the remainder of the 2015-16 season.... He spent his freshman year at Roselle Catholic before transferring to Pope John for his sophomore season. King is going on his third school in as many years." At Hudson Catholic, he was teammates with [[Jahvon Quinerly]]. Prior to the 2017–18 season, he was named to the [[Naismith Prep Player of the Year Award]] watch list.{{cite web |title=2017 Naismith Boys' High School Watch List Announced |url=http://naismithtrophy.com/2017-naismith-boys-high-school-watch-list/ |website=naismithtrophy.com |access-date=August 25, 2018 |date=November 14, 2017 |archive-date=July 22, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180722102704/http://naismithtrophy.com/2017-naismith-boys-high-school-watch-list/ |url-status=live }} During his senior year, he suffered a knee injury after landing awkwardly after a dunk.{{cite web |last1=Zagoria |first1=Adam |title=Future Ducks Bol & King Anxious To Return After Missing All-American Game |url=https://www.flohoops.com/articles/6158112-future-ducks-bol-king-anxious-to-return-after-missing-all-american-game |website=flohoops.com |access-date=August 25, 2018 |date=March 28, 2018 |archive-date=August 25, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825143242/https://www.flohoops.com/articles/6158112-future-ducks-bol-king-anxious-to-return-after-missing-all-american-game |url-status=live }} Despite a shortened season, King averaged 15.2 points and 4.4 rebounds. He was named to the [[2018 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2018 McDonald's All-American]] team and invited to the 2018 [[Nike Hoop Summit]], but was not able to participate due to the injury.{{cite web |last1=Prehm |first1=Matt |title=Bol Bol and Louis King dealing with injuries |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/bol-bol-and-louis-king-dealing-with-injuries/ |work=[[CBS Sports]] |access-date=August 25, 2018 |date=March 28, 2018 |archive-date=August 25, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825110359/https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/bol-bol-and-louis-king-dealing-with-injuries/ |url-status=live }} ===Recruiting=== King was ranked among the top 25 prospects of the 2018 recruiting class by [[Rivals.com|Rivals]], [[247Sports.com|247Sports]], and [[ESPN]]. 💛🫡 Te deseamos el mayor de los éxitos en tu próximo reto.|number=1870137523466375577|user=CapitanesCDMX|date=December 20, 2024|access-date=December 20, 2024|language=Spanish}} ===Fujian Sturgeons (2024–2025)=== On December 20, 2024, King signed with the [[Fujian Sturgeons]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].{{cite web|title=【官宣∣欢迎路易斯·金加入福建SBS浔兴大家庭】 福建SBS浔兴篮球俱乐部已与外籍球员路易斯·金 (Louis King) 完成签约, 并已通过CBA公司审核公示, 将代表福建晋江文旅男篮开始征战本赛季CBA联赛。路易斯·金 (Louis King), 1999年4月6日出生于美国, 身高201cm, 体重93kg, 场上司职前锋。路易斯金在2019年NBA选秀落选后，先后效力过活塞、国王、76人等NBA球队。2021年路易斯·金代表国王参加NBA夏季联赛并夺得冠军，个人荣膺总决赛MVP殊荣。 2024年3月，路易斯·金代表Criollos de Caguas 俱乐部征战波多黎各 BSN 联赛32场，场均上场33.3分钟能够砍下18.6分5.9篮板2.7助攻，并两次获选联赛周最佳球员。 希望路易斯·金在比赛中能充分发挥自己的技术特点，帮助福建晋江文旅男篮在本赛季之后的比赛中取得更好的成绩。 #cba##福建男篮[超话]#福建男篮超话|url=https://weibo.com/2813085690/P5R71p8x8|website=Weibo.com|date=December 20, 2024|access-date=December 21, 2024|language=Chinese}} === Xinjiang Flying Tigers (2025-2026) === On November 7, 2025, King signed with the [[Xinjiang Flying Tigers]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].{{Cite web |title=Sina Visitor System |url=https://passport.weibo.com/visitor/visitor?entry=miniblog&a=enter&url=https%3A%2F%2Fweibo.com%2F1828625142%2F5230107451200864&domain=weibo.com&ua=Mozilla%2F5.0%20%28Macintosh%3B%20Intel%20Mac%20OS%20X%2010_15_7%29%20AppleWebKit%2F537.36%20%28KHTML%2C%20like%20Gecko%29%20Chrome%2F110.0.0.0%20Safari%2F537.36%20Citoid%2FWMF%20%28mailto%3Anoc%40wikimedia.org%29&_rand=1762515156293&sudaref= |access-date=2025-11-07 |website=passport.weibo.com}} ===Criollos de Caguas (2026-present)=== King returned for the start of the 2026 [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional|BSN]] season. He joined [[Travis Trice]] and [[Moses Brown (basketball)|Moses Brown]] as the three imports. He was selected as a starter for the 2026 [[BSN All-Star Game]]. On May 25, 2026, King had his best game of the season, having a near [[triple-double]] performance.
